track_name: Oulton Park Circuit - Intl w/no Chicanes
title: Track Guide Oulton Park INT W/O Chicanes Toyota GR86 iRacing

corners.braking: Brake at the banner with yellow text, 70% pressure, ease off to mid track.
corners.line: Roll into the corner, cut the inside curb, accelerate before the dip.
corners.exit: Accelerate using the outside curb, avoid the grass.
corners.mistakes: Cut too much inside curb, touch grass to spin the car.

corners.label: T2
corners.line: Go out wide for turn two.

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: 70% brake pressure, trail brake to inside curb.
corners.line: Apex about a car length before no-cut zone, use outside curb on exit.
corners.exit: Pick up throttle at apex, use outside curb, avoid grass.
corners.mistakes: Cut too much inside curb, touch grass to spin the car.

corners.label: T4
corners.line: Aim for end of inside curb as apex.
corners.mistakes: Stay on right side of track to avoid overtaking.

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: break once at the end of the tire wall, 80% pressure, trail brake to top
corners.line: aim for end of inside curb as apex
corners.exit: pick up throttle at top, use outside curb for speed
corners.mistakes: stay close to inside curb, avoid outside curb too early

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: brake at first curb on left, 80% pressure, trail brake to inside grass
corners.exit: pick up throttle past inside grass, avoid bump
corners.mistakes: don't cut grass too aggressively, avoid going wide

corners.label: T11
corners.braking: Break just before the dip, 90% brake pressure, trail off to emergency road
corners.exit: Pick up throttle, use exit curve
corners.mistakes: Do not hit curb, do not take too much curb

general_tips: In the race, stay on the right side of the track for turn four.
be on the left side of the track for turn 10 in qualifying
In qualifying, be on the left side of the track for turn 11
